 College basketball games today: Kentucky, Illinois and Arizona headline 18-game Friday exhibition schedule 
 Friday features a loaded preseason schedule with Texas Tech visiting Kentucky, Baylor traveling to Illinois and Minnesota facing Creighton. Here are the confirmed matchups, tipoff times and available broadcast details. By Rodney Knuppel | Oct 23, 2026, 8:16 AM EDT Share on Facebook Share on X Share on Reddit Copy Article Add us as a preferred source Tommy Lloyd | USA TODAY Network via Reuters Connect College basketball fans have plenty to watch Friday, October 23, as an entertaining exhibition schedule features 18 games across the country. Several nationally prominent programs will face challenging opponents before the regular season begins, including Kentucky hosting Texas Tech and Illinois welcoming Baylor. Minnesota also visits Creighton, while Arizona concludes its exhibition schedule against Eastern Washington. The combination of major-conference matchups, regional rivalries and mid-major opportunities makes Friday one of the busiest days of the preseason.

Friday's schedule also features several programs adjusting to new coaching staffs or significant roster changes. Fans interested in identifying potential breakout teams will have numerous opportunities to watch basketball throughout the afternoon and evening.
